quote: I have tried every to-do app on earth and I still end up with a list of 40 things and no idea what to actually do first.
Time blocking changed my life but maintaining the blocks by hand is its own part-time job.
Every productivity app works for two weeks and then I abandon it like all the others.
I don't need another app telling me what to do, I need it to actually adapt when my day blows up at 10am.
Honestly I'm suspicious of anything that wants access to my whole calendar.
